generation_prompt: The humanoid uses its right hand to grasp the grey duster around its fluffy head, lift it from the table, and offer the exposed handle to a person. It holds the duster while the person grasps the handle, then opens its right hand to release it as the person carries it away and out of view. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The person has carried the duster out through image left; the table is clear of the duster, and the humanoid's right hand is empty and lowered near its right side. Its left hand remains empty near the lap.

arm_hand_roles.right: Active manipulation hand. Reaches to the duster, grips around its fluffy head, lifts and presents its handle, maintains support while the person grasps, then opens to release and retracts empty.
arm_hand_roles.left: Idle empty hand near the robot's left thigh/lap throughout; it neither supports nor manipulates the duster.
arm_hand_roles.person: Visible hand takes the exposed handle while the robot still holds the fluffy head, then withdraws with the released duster.

uncertainties: Fluffy material partially occludes the exact right-finger contact points and the first instant of release; native frames 210–216 show the hand opening and separation, and the subsequent removal establishes the completed handover.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
